answer: Score identities by the maximum trust-flow they can draw from an established honest core, where each edge carries limited capacity. A sybil nebula spins up endless internal edges, but its only link to the real graph is a thin plume of a few attack edges, and max-flow is capped by that bottleneck cut, not by how many fakes hide behind it. So a swarm of ten thousand clones receives the same trickle of trust as the handful of edges feeding it; the honest pulse of endorsement cannot reach the whole farm.
